text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki got injured during practice,
so I brought her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
...I guess I... can't really say I'm fine... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Pretty convincing, wasn't it?
I do have quite the knack for dramatic acting, after all."
choice_data_list: That was just acting, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even though it was a scene into which I poured everything,
you saw right through it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my master director... what shall we do next?
I leave everything entirely in your hands...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my master director... what shall we do next?
I leave everything entirely in your hands...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Maybe I'll... take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmmm...
What should I do about dorm patrol tonight...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And I also want to make my little ponies' wishes come true...
choice_data_list: Right now, your health comes first!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right...
For now, I'll focus on taking care of my body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To let her rest both body and mind, I kept watch over
Fuji Kiseki for a while.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, you're right. This isn't the place where I need to put on a resolute face."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To return to my stage... I have to prepare for the race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "First, let's think up a training routine that won't put strain on your injury."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry... The pain's making it hard to concentrate...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I'll leave our future plans up to you, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plagued by pain, Fuji Kiseki was completely
unable to focus on anything...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For a while, train the parts that aren't injured...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right! Thinking ahead to after the injury heals,
let's do some mental training too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I have to do everything I possibly can right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to a regimen tailored to minimize strain on her injury, Fuji Kiseki recovered faster than expected!
